title: Move-in cost overview
text: In Japan, move-in costs may include the first month of rent, deposit, agency fee, and additional charges such as key money depending on the property. Users should review each fee separately and ask for a full written cost breakdown before signing.

title: Rental process expectations
text: International renters may encounter language barriers, detailed paperwork expectations, and, in some cases, guarantor requirements. Property listings can differ significantly in size, rules, and included amenities, so it is important to verify the details of each apartment carefully.

title: Living in Japan basics
text: Visa type depends on the purpose of stay, such as work, study, or family status. After arrival, users may need to complete local administrative steps related to address registration and residence documentation. Official guidance should be checked for current requirements.
